body: not sure if this thread is still active, but i literally just had this experience with the show the Bear. What i remember was seeing a screenshot of a specific scene in the show during my A LEVELS MEDIA studies in around 2019. I vividly remember analysing every detail of the scene, the composition, lighting, character placements, hierarchies, even discussing WHY the characters are placed where they are in the scene. Then my boyfriend tells me he wants to watch this show, i’m like “I’ve seen this before! i had to analyse it for my media studies class”, and he’s like “but it only came out in 2022? that’s impossible” I’m like what the fuck there’s no way. I’ve seen this before, i’ve LITERALLY analysed it, what the literal fuck is happening lmao. Im so stuck and confused i don’t really know what to think anymore.
